summary: Iteration 4 — async-job refactor for /api/scripts/{long,shorts,repurpose} VERIFIED end-to-end on the PUBLIC preview URL. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (test_scripts.py rewritten to expect the new async-job shape: POST returns {id,status:'running'} in <1s, then poll GET /api/scripts/job/{id} every 3s until terminal). Three real Claude generations completed via polling on the public preview URL — long-form (with all 8 ### section headers), shorts (all 9 sections), repurpose (mode='shorts' platform='reels', SHORT-FORM SCRIPT present). The Cloudflare 60s edge timeout that killed iteration 3's /api/scripts/long is gone — confirmed because every POST returned in <1s and every poll request individually completed in <30s, so no single request crossed the edge timeout. Negative paths verified: invalid length/platform/empty topic → 400; unauthenticated POST → 401; GET /api/scripts/job/{nonexistent} → 404; GET /api/scripts/job/{id} without auth → 401 (ownership check via user_email in mongo query — see server.py:714). History returns in descending created_at order, GET by id and DELETE work, DELETE missing → 404, DELETE then GET → 404. /api/studio/broll-prompts unchanged: returns 5 cleanly-formatted prompts for a sample script. Frontend: full e2e UI test passed on the public preview URL — long-form generation, button shows 'Writing… 3s' (and increments), output appeared with all 8 long-mode section cards, no scripts-error appeared during the long-poll window (previously this 502'd at 60s and surfaced 'Could not generate'). 'Cut into a Short' label flipped to 'Cutting into a Short…' during the repurpose job and result switched to all 9 shorts section cards. Send-to-Studio handoff from a history-loaded long script pre-filled script-textarea (15,967 chars) AND cleared the f48_handoff_script localStorage key. Studio's 'Generate from script' button still works — filled bulk-prompts with 12 clean B-roll prompts in faceless mode. NO REGRESSIONS, NO NEW BUGS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:750 has dead variable `LENGTH_VALID_DEPRECATED = None` that should be removed; LENGTH_VALID was moved up near the engine block which is the right fix, but the comment-style placeholder left behind is noise.

server.py: _run_script_job() uses asyncio.create_task() without keeping a reference. If the FastAPI worker is recycled/restarted while a long job is in-flight, the task is silently dropped and the script row will stay status='running' forever. Consider (a) tracking tasks in a module-level set and awaiting on shutdown, OR (b) a startup task that re-queries running scripts older than ~10min and marks them failed. Not blocking, but a real edge case for production.
server.py:558 doc comment is now accurate but the dead comment block at server.py:750 (LENGTH_VALID_DEPRECATED) is misleading — drop it.

Frontend Scripts.jsx: pollJob() interval is 2.5s — fine, but on a slow Claude job (~100s) that's ~40 polling requests per generation. Consider exponential-ish backoff (poll every 2s for first 20s, then 4s after) to halve request volume. Not blocking.

Frontend Scripts.jsx: when the user navigates away from /scripts mid-generation, the useEffect cleanup correctly clears pollRef, but the backend job keeps running and the result is silently orphaned (will show up in history on return). That's actually fine behavior — just worth noting in product docs.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 3's Cloudflare 60s edge timeout on /api/scripts/long is RESOLVED. Mechanism: POST /api/scripts/long now inserts a mongo record with status='running' and spawns _run_script_job() via asyncio.create_task(), returning the record in <1s. The frontend polls GET /api/scripts/job/{id} every 2.5s; each individual poll completes in <30s. Because no single HTTP request crosses the ~60s Cloudflare edge limit, the proxy never times out. Verified empirically: long-form POST completed in <1s, polling completed the full 17K-char generation in ~120s, all 8 ### section headers present in the final `text` field. Identical pattern now used for /api/scripts/shorts and /api/scripts/repurpose for safety margin and consistency.
